prompt:
Build a Simulink model of a planar rocket flight system from powered ascent through post-burn trajectory and terminal descent or the 350-second horizon. The model shall couple a time-dependent thrust program, propellant consumption and changing vehicle mass, altitude-dependent aerodynamic drag, gravity and Earth-curvature flight-path dynamics, and commanded-versus-actual pitch dynamics. The trajectory must respond causally to mass-flow command, payload mass, and gravity-turn command; do not prescribe trajectory outputs directly.

Read the scalar workspace inputs mass_flow_kg_per_s, payload_mass_kg, and gravity_turn_angle_rad. Support mass flow from 120 to 145 kg/s, payload mass from 4500 to 6500 kg, and gravity-turn command from 0.08 to 0.15 rad. Simulate from 0 seconds until a physically implemented terminal event stops the model or 350 seconds is reached. Save the final model as cand_XAERO08.slx.

Record complete finite Timeseries covering the model's entire actual run in these containers. flight_state shall have five columns in this order: altitude (m), downrange distance (m), signed speed along the flight path (m/s), flight-path angle (rad), and vehicle pitch angle (rad). propulsion_state shall have four columns: thrust (N), initial usable propellant mass (kg), ascent propellant consumed (kg), and terminal-burn propellant consumed (kg). guidance_attitude_state shall have four columns: gravity-turn command (rad), commanded pitch angle (rad), actual pitch angle (rad), and pitch-rate (rad/s). Time vectors shall begin at zero, be strictly increasing, contain at least 50 samples, and end at the actual simulation terminal time.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAERO08.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
